tool_review_canonicalization: sha256 of json.dumps({'read': sorted(read), 'write': sorted(write)}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) over src/camel/adapters/agentdojo/runtime.py SUITE_TOOL_REVIEWS

execution.assignment: one suite per person; three groups in parallel within that suite

metrics.defense: attack_goal ASR by suite, group and attack family with planned denominator and Wilson interval
metrics.utility: benign task completion, including the expected WRITE subset
metrics.usability: B3 confirmation decisions / all B3 decisions
metrics.errors: native errors, tool errors, timeouts and unrun episodes remain explicit unknowns

limitations: tool_knowledge can raise when an injection ground truth lacks placeholder_args; such episodes remain NATIVE_ERROR in the planned denominator.
